design_philosophy: Extract the aesthetic from the 'Hook' app reference and wrap it around ALL existing HYPD Gaming features. Features heavy use of soft blur gradients, friendly 'squircle' corner radiuses, floating pill-shaped navigation, and high contrast typography. Keep the neon lime green accent as the core HYPD brand identity.

typography.rules: Never use Inter or Roboto. Use DM Sans or Plus Jakarta Sans. Make headings bold and lowercase where appropriate for a trendy feel. Maintain clean, modern, rounded typographic forms.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur for action bar buttons on the game feed (dark circle rgba(0,0,0,0.5) with backdrop-blur-md) and potentially the bottom nav.

bottom_navigation.design: Floating pill bar. Does NOT touch screen edges (margin: 0 16px 20px). border-radius: 999px. Height: ~64px.
bottom_navigation.active_state: Active tab gets #AAFF00 neon green circle background behind icon. Icon and text become black/dark. Inactive icons are #888888.
bottom_navigation.layout: 5 tabs: Feed, Explore, Defence, Leaders, Profile. Icon size 22px, label 11px below.

buttons.primary: Full-width or wide, border-radius: 20px (md). Gradient fill #7748F8 to #A259FF for auth/non-gaming. Solid #AAFF00 for game play actions.
buttons.secondary_ghost: Full-width pill (radius 999px), transparent bg, dark text in light mode, off-white in dark mode, thin border.
buttons.feed_action_buttons: Dark circle rgba(0,0,0,0.5) backdrop-blur with white icon (for Play/Save/Heart).

cards.game_cards: border-radius: 24px (squircle). Overflow hidden, full image cover, title + meta overlay at bottom. Used in feed/explore.
cards.leaderboard_rows: border-radius: 20px. White card bg (light) / #1E1E1E (dark). Soft shadow in light mode. Row flex layout.
cards.category_tiles: border-radius: 20px. Unique gradient background fills. Icon centered, label below.

inputs.design: border-radius: 16px, height 56px. Icon on the left inside field.

layouts.global: Mobile-first, max-width 430px container centered on larger screens, full-height scroll. Background contains the top bleed gradient.
layouts.feed_page: TikTok-style full-screen video game feed. Cards have squircle radiuses (24px). Floating rounded Play button, circular Save/heart button. Scrollable pill-shaped category filter chips at top.
layouts.explore_page: Bold lowercase section headers. Horizontal scroll rows. SmallCards (squircle), BigCards for trending.
layouts.leaderboard_page: Page title with trophy icon. Pill tabs with #AAFF00 active state. Ranked user rows (card style, radius 20px) containing rank badge, rounded avatar, username, and stats.
layouts.profile_page: Large rounded inputs and gradient primary CTA button for auth. Logged in: large rounded avatar, streak badge, stats cards, tabs.
layouts.game_player: Full-screen iframe. Floating bottom bar with game title, rounded neon green Play button, circular Save/heart. Soft pill Back button.

motion.interactions: Add smooth hover/active scale-down effects (e.g., scale 0.98 on tap) for all squircle and pill buttons.
motion.page_transitions: Soft fade and slide-up for modals or new pages.
motion.feed: Snap scroll for the TikTok-style feed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text #1A1A1A on light and #F0F0F0 on dark meets contrast ratios against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Use subtle ring outline for focus states on inputs and buttons.

media.images: All game thumbnails must use border-radius: 24px (squircle). Maintain aspect ratios.

image_urls.description: Fantasy game artwork for game cards

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Define CSS variables for the color system in globals.css under :root and .dark selectors. Add the gradient utility classes.
2. Implement the BottomNav component in /app/frontend/src/components/bottom-nav.js using the floating pill design.
3. Update the main feed page in /app/frontend/src/app/page.js applying squircle radiuses and backdrop-blur action buttons.
4. Update the Explore page components applying horizontal scroll, squircle cards, and lowercase bold headers.
5. Restyle Leaderboard rows as radius-20px cards with soft shadows in light mode.
6. Update Profile/Auth forms with 16px radius inputs, no borders, and large gradient CTAs.
7. Set the font to DM Sans in layout.js.
8. Ensure the app maintains max-width: 430px for the mobile-first layout.
9. ALWAYS include data-testid on interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...). Pages MUST use default exports.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
